correctness.rationale: The PL orbit-coordinate map and explicit inverse are valid on every face, including forbidden or empty orbit sets. Barycentric subdivision, a canonical fixed center and equivariant parent map prove quotient acyclicity for arbitrary tree stabilizers; components reduce separately. The leaf-neighbor suspension proof handles isolated and empty residual graphs. The reduced simplicial Lefschetz number gives the claimed sign on the rank-one integral homology line. The included checker independently verifies orbit faces, mod-two homology and Lefschetz values for 289 finite actions, but the proof supplies the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The result answers the natural equivariant extension of the canonical forest independence-complex classification uniformly for all finite forests and all subgroups: a fixed space of an arbitrary simplicial group action could have complicated integral homotopy, but here it has an explicit smaller forest model, a complete elementary dimension algorithm, and an integral orientation character for every spherical ambient case. The central three-two-edge-arm spider illustrates fixed spheres of three distinct dimensions under related subgroup actions. This is a structural class-closure and all-subgroup classification, not a parameter rename or one-off finite table.
